content_html:
Key Developments

On September 11, 2026, CBSNews.com will publish a special video presentation offering a historical review of the September 11 attacks. This retrospective aims to revisit the pivotal events of 9/11, which reshaped global security and international relations. Central to the discussion will be the figure of Osama bin Laden, the founder and leader of the al-Qaeda terrorist network, widely recognized as the mastermind behind the devastating attacks.

The video will also explore Afghanistan's historical context as a "safe haven." This refers to the period when the Taliban regime provided sanctuary and operational bases for al-Qaeda, allowing the group to plan and execute attacks, including 9/11, from within its borders. The narrative will likely examine the geopolitical implications of this arrangement and the subsequent international response.

Key Takeaways

  • CBSNews.com will release a video retrospective on September 11, 2026, focusing on the 9/11 attacks.
  • The feature will examine Osama bin Laden's role as the architect of the attacks.
  • It will also explore Afghanistan's significance as a safe haven for al-Qaeda prior to and during the 9/11 events.

Why It Matters

The September 11 attacks remain a defining moment in modern history, profoundly influencing counter-terrorism strategies, foreign policy, and domestic security measures worldwide. A retrospective from CBS News, particularly one focusing on Osama bin Laden and Afghanistan's role, offers an opportunity to reflect on the origins and consequences of these events. Understanding the historical context of how terrorist organizations operated from safe havens, and the leadership that orchestrated such attacks, is crucial for ongoing efforts to combat global terrorism and prevent future tragedies. This video serves as a reminder of the enduring legacy of 9/11 and its continued relevance in contemporary geopolitical discussions.
